why_best: Staccato, tactile motion gives high-density editorial graphics an authoritative physical weight that demands viewer focus in vertical feeds.
why_bad: Ultra-smooth digital interpolations would flatten the artisanal character, turning an impactful editorial statement into generic broadcast filler.
trap: A weak execution will smooth out the subtle edge vibration during quiet moments, causing the visual elements to feel frozen and lifeless rather than handcrafted.
